احتقبن (form VIII)
# اِحْتَقَبْنَ (iḥtaqabna) /iħ.ta.qab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
# اُحْتُقِبْنَ (uḥtuqibna) /uħ.tu.qib.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
# اِحْتَقِبْنَ (iḥtaqibna) /iħ.ta.qib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
